# Public health emergencies of international concern: a historic overview
## Public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC)
### Box 1
Since 2007, there have been six PHEIC declarations, [5](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7798963/#ref5) starting with the H1N1 pandemic in 2009. [Table 1](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7798963/#TB1) summarizes the dates and the recommendations of those six PHEIC.

web.title: Public health emergency of international concern
web.description:
Since 2005, there have been nine PHEIC declarations: the [2009–2010 H1N1 (or swine flu) pandemic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2009_swine_flu_pandemic), the ongoing [2014 polio declaration](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polio_eradication#2011%E2%80%932015), the [2013–2016 outbreak of Ebola in Western Africa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Western_African_Ebola_epidemic), the [2015–16 Zika virus epidemic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2015%E2%80%9316_Zika_virus_epidemic),[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_health_emergency_of_international_concern#cite_note-Hunger2018-5) the [2018–2020 Kivu Ebola epidemic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kivu_Ebola_epidemic),[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_health_emergency_of_international_concern#cite_note-WHO18Oct2019-6) the 2020–2023 declaration for the [COVID-19 pandemic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/COVID-19_pandemic),[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_health_emergency_of_international_concern#cite_note-:0-7) the [2022–2023](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022%E2%80%932023_mpox_outbreak) and [2024 mpox outbreaks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023%E2%80%932026_mpox_epidemic),[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_health_emergency_of_international_concern#cite_note-WHO.mpox.2024-8)[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_health_emergency_of_international_concern#cite_note-WHO.15Aug2024-9) and the [2026 Ituri Province Ebola epidemic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Ituri_Province_Ebola_epidemic).

## Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC)
##### List of all Public Health Emergencies of International Concern (PHEIC)
###### Since 2009 there are been seven (7) PHEIC declarations:
- [H1N1](https://www.cdc.gov/h1n1flu/qa.htm) [("Swine Flu") Influenza Pandemic](http://www.cdc.gov/h1n1flu/qa.htm)(2009–2010)
- [Polio declaration](https://www.cdc.gov/polio/index.htm) (2014–Present)
- [COVID-19 Pandemic](https://www.cdc.gov/coronavirus/2019-ncov/index.html) (2020–2023)

## Abstract
### Background
There have been seven PHEIC declarations, including for the 2009 H1N1 flu pandemic, Ebola and Polio outbreaks, the COVID-19 pandemic, and most recently, the mpox outbreak.

## Background
Since the IHR was finalized in 2005, there have been seven PHEIC declarations, including for the 2009 H1N1 flu pandemic, Ebola and Polio outbreaks, the COVID-19 pandemic, and most recently, the mpox outbreak.
